data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement (inconclusive vs safe) was caused by a tool error (HTTP 400 API failure) in the qwen model when attempting to audit saxonche_setup.py, not by a genuine security concern. The deepseek model successfully audited this file and found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review saxonche_setup.py due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors so a single file failure doesn't result in an inconclusive package verdict if another model successfully audited the file.
Aggregate file-level verdicts across models before determining the final package verdict to prevent a single model's tool error from blocking a safe resolution.
